 Raigarh, District Raigarh (Cg)
 ---- Appell
 Versus
  The State Of Chhattisgarh through D. M. Raigarh (Cg)
 ---- Responden
Mr. Vipin Singh Thakur, counsel for appellant.

21.02.2023 Mr. Praveen Shrivastava & Himanshu
Kumar Sharma, P.L. for State.
In terms of the order dated 17.01.2023 the appellant has been arrested and brought before this Court.
Heard on I.A. No.02 which is an application for cancellation of warrant and grant of bail.

The newly engaged counsel for appellant submits that the appellant is a rustic villager and that ignorant of the date of appearance the appellant had gone for earning his livelihood to a different State and therefore he could not appear before this Court on a given date.
Counsel for appellant submits that the non- appearance of appellant was never deliberate and with malafide and prayed for grant of bail.

State counsel on the other hand opposing the bail application submits that the appeal is of the year 2002 and the appellant stands convicted under section 376 of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 10 years, therefore, the appellant does not deserve to be released on bail.

Having heard the submission put forth by the counsel for appellant and also considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case particularly taking note of the fact that the appellant was on bail during trial as also during the pendency of the appeal before this Court till the warrant of arrest was issued by this Court on default of appearance, this Court is of the opinion that a strong case for allowing the application is made out.
